item.description:
About me

This website is where I share what I'm learning and a little of life outside the classroom.

About my website

I created this website for my Web Programming class. Dr. Tashfeen gave us creative freedom, so I brought a little Clash Royale inspiration to it.

I build the pages with HTML and CSS, manage the files through GitHub, and publish the site with GitHub Pages. The design uses Playfair Display headings, a light gray background, deep burgundy text, and gold accents. Each revision is a chance to practice what I'm learning.

item.title: My Favorite Mobile Game | Matteuss
item.description:
How I Started

I started played Clash royale around 8 years ago. It was just normal game back then when no one played it. I just wanted to do same thing what my friends did. Around 2 years ago I created new account so i can re-start it from 0. Since then Clash been on it's peak and I am playing whenever i am bored and trying to kill time.
